name: native-capacitor-push-ios
//: The plugin's Swift sources and the TrinityPush package (trinity-ios:test-push), split from the TypeScript project native-capacitor-push so that Nx maps these files here (the deepest project root owns a file). Owned by the TypeScript project, a native-only edit marked every TypeScript dependent affected; trinity-ios reaches this project through an implicit dependency instead, so the edit still marks the iOS host and its targets. An .nxignore entry would not do: Nx drops ignored files from affected and hashing altogether, the iOS host included. The plugin manifest ../Package.swift has to stay at the package root, where Capacitor looks for it, so it remains a file of the TypeScript project.
